clusters.name: bg-subagent-detector
clusters.executionModeRationale: Must run serially. US-001 is a hard feasibility prerequisite (the Phase-0 probe/fixture must prove the start->done correlation key before any detector code is written), and every subsequent story edits the same 2-3 hook files (detect-active-bg.js, stop.js, listener-protocol.js) plus the same shared test and doc/version-stamp files. Parallel execution would produce conflicting same-file edits and could build a detector before the fixture validates the schema.
